## Property address enrichment
1. Edit **Input addresses** (maximum 10).
2. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential: name `x-apivex-key`, value your APIVex key. Select it in **Look up property**.
3. Execute manually. Inspect **Review results**; `returned` means a property was returned, not that its address was verified.
Requests consume quota. This starter makes one request per unique address, with no automatic retries. Errors remain in output; fix them before rerunning. No schedule is enabled.
Guide: https://apivex.com/workflows/property-address-enrichment
